inventory.anchor: UNIFIED_SOURCES of netwerk/base (StealthIPv6Literal.cpp, after the TRRLoadInfo.cpp line that ends the list)
inventory.notes: Registers StealthIPv6Literal.cpp, which holds the rule that a connect to an IPv6 literal fails as on a host with no IPv6 route when IPv6 is disabled.

Every direct TCP connection passes InitiateSocket: PR_Connect becomes StealthIPv6Connect, which, with IPv6 declared off, fails a routable IPv6 destination like a host with no IPv6 route (network unreachable, nothing sent). A destination behind a SOCKS proxy is left alone: the proxy reaches it, not this host. One line of Mozilla replaced.

inventory.anchor: include of StealthIPv6Literal.h; nsSOCKSSocketInfo::ConnectToProxy (the connect to the proxy)
inventory.notes: The layer's connect to its proxy goes through StealthHopConnect, which sends nothing and fails as a failed connect when the route rule refuses the hop, and otherwise is the layer's own connect. Mozilla's sub-expression and arguments stay inside our call.
